checks: Independently replayed all 216 original-instruction fixtures in an isolated output directory; the runs passed with original 0x6262 executing and the stated 0x623C/0x6352/0x6294 boundaries controlled.

Decoded the 6384 flag flow and the 6262 arithmetic. When original low flag bits equal 1, the caller forms R0 from row byte+56 with bit 7 cleared and passes context byte+0x4E in R1; 6262 computes 1 << (((R0 & 3) + R1 + 1) & 0xFF), with ARM register-shift behavior. For negative row byte, the preceding controlled 6352 return updates byte+56 before this load, which the fixture model accounts for.

The parent-model fixtures include immediate width errors from the actual shift result, preserve status/minimum behavior, and check helper calls, writes, return status, and SP. The separately reviewed 1415 mixed mode/width supplement remains a no-helper path and is not conflated with these controlled-helper fixtures.
limitations: The 623C, 6352, and 6294 helper effects are controlled; the replay does not establish their real behavior or physical effects. It is limited to the specified row profiles and does not prove arbitrary mixed-row behavior, pointer validity, concurrency, or canonical admission.
